question: Should LongCat’s Automatic cookie source expand from the repository’s Chrome-only default to silently probe Firefox for existing users?
rationale: The code is small and the Firefox-only proof is credible, but the remaining choice is a product/privacy compatibility policy for all existing Automatic users rather than a mechanical correctness issue.

options.title: Keep Firefox opt-in
options.body: Preserve Chrome-only Automatic behavior and route Firefox through an explicit browser-list selection so users choose the additional browser probe.

options.title: Approve a LongCat exception
options.body: Accept Chrome-then-Firefox as LongCat’s documented default and explicitly own the expanded Automatic browser probing on upgrade.

recommendation.title: Keep Firefox opt-in
recommendation.body: Preserve Chrome-only Automatic behavior and route Firefox through an explicit browser-list selection so users choose the additional browser probe.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level default and cookie-import policy decision rather than a narrow code repair.
